comparison.paired_effect: candidate minus baseline exact-field-agreement proportion for the exact fixture, replicate, seed and control condition
comparison.retry_unit: attempt nested within arm run; never a replicate or independent sample
comparison.uncertainty: unavailable for population inference in this three-fixture synthetic smoke pack; report pair and fixture-cluster counts without invented precision
comparison.causal_claim: not supported without a separately preregistered randomized assignment and order design

cohort_and_sampling.basis: the three frozen fixture IDs crossed with preregistered arm, replicate, order and cache conditions
cohort_and_sampling.sampling: fixed census of this named synthetic fixture pack; not a probability sample and not representative of production tasks
cohort_and_sampling.admission: freeze fixture, rubric, cohort, cases, pair IDs, conditions and primary outcome before execution
cohort_and_sampling.closure: close only after each scheduled arm is terminal or its declared budget/deadline makes it censored; retain incomplete arms
cohort_and_sampling.missing_or_aborted: count and preserve unresolved, censored and aborted arms separately; exclude incomplete pairs without imputation

run_state_semantics: completed means the benchmark evaluation invocation produced a schema-valid result; it does not mean the represented task was accepted, succeeded or satisfied
run_record_unit: one fixture_id x pair_id/replicate_id x arm; each arm run covers exactly one fixture

pair_eligibility.planned_pair_identity: predeclare every fixture, pair, replicate, arm, order and cache cell before execution
pair_eligibility.incomplete_pair_disposition: retain both arm states and reason codes; exclude from paired effect; never impute zero
pair_eligibility.missing_arm_disposition: retain the scheduled arm as unavailable with missing_run_record reason; do not erase it from the planned cohort or score it as zero
pair_eligibility.unresolved_version_disposition: if actual harness/model identity cannot be resolved, emit no comparable run record; retain the planned arm as unavailable with version_unavailable reason
pair_eligibility.non_comparison_version_rule: model ID and resolved version must match on harness comparisons; harness version and commit must match on model comparisons
pair_eligibility.comparison_version_rule: the selected axis identity tuple must differ: (harness version, commit) or (model ID, resolved version)

controls.held_out_labels: labels are in a separate artifact and must not be included in runner/model input; score only after output is frozen
controls.workspace: create a distinct disposable workspace per arm from the same pinned template; do not reuse mutable workspace state
controls.memory_snapshot: record the exact frozen snapshot digest when memory is present; otherwise record an explicit not-applicable state and reason
controls.reset_and_washout: record reset protocol and washout duration for every arm; apply the same protocol before each run
controls.order: record assigned baseline-first or candidate-first order and arm position; counterbalance across preregistered pair blocks
controls.cache: record cold or warm cache state; stratify results and never pool these conditions implicitly
controls.versions: record actual harness version and commit, actual model ID and resolved version, plus fixture/rubric/protocol digests; no defaults or inferred versions
